verdict.rationale: vLLM's official docs explicitly list a broad range of quantization formats spanning very low-bit (INT4, MXFP4, NVFP4, GPTQ/AWQ) up to 8-bit (INT8, FP8), directly matching the power-user's need to shrink memory footprint via integer quantization. An older community comment (vllm-comm-1) claims 4-bit wasn't supported, but this predates the current documented INT4/AWQ/GPTQ support and isn't a concrete contradiction of the current capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks confirming memory savings at each precision level, and no evidence of ease-of-use details for switching between quantization schemes.
